contract: PRD PR-009 (no LLM credentials, no LLM binary/provider, no LLM fallback); ARD F3; goal.ttl v23:GC23-5; lane R1-X-GUARD
law: Fail closed. The no-LLM court environment admits a variable only when its NAME is listed under environment; every other variable is refused by Xaas.Ultracode.SemanticDrive.no_llm_guard/1 -- REFUSED(llm_credential_present) when a provider below claims its name, else REFUSED(unadmitted_environment) -- and an executable named by a provider's binaries in any PATH directory is REFUSED(llm_credential_present). Only NAMES and binary paths are reported, never values. providers is the reporting vocabulary (which provider leaked), not the admission rule: a name no provider claims is still refused. One source: docs/sjira/v26.9.23/courts/no_llm_env.sh builds the court environment from this file (path_tools, system_path, the caller_or_default and caller_if_set entries, every provider binary) and the guard is compiled from it.

origins.caller_or_default: durable toolchain configuration: the caller's value, else the default (~/ is the caller's HOME)
origins.caller_if_set: durable configuration passed through only when the caller sets it
origins.court_assignment: not passed through; admitted when a court names it as NAME=value before --
origins.launcher: set inside the process by the toolchain launcher chain (erl, elixir, sh, the asdf shim, macOS CoreFoundation), never by the builder
origins.drive: set by the no-LLM drive for its own child processes (Xaas.Ultracode.SemanticDrive, RecipeWorker, SemanticWork)

environment.name: HOME
environment.why: a fresh mktemp dir, removed afterwards

environment.name: PATH
environment.why: the resolved (symlink-free) directories of path_tools plus system_path; a directory holding a provider binary makes the builder refuse (exit 75, UNKNOWN)

environment.name: DEV_DB_USERNAME
environment.why: local test database (durable configuration, not a model credential)

environment.name: DEV_DB_PASSWORD
environment.why: local test database (durable configuration, not a model credential)

environment.name: TMPDIR
environment.why: the court's scratch root (GC23-12 passes TMPDIR=<tmp>/ to mix xaas.successor)

environment.name: PWD
environment.why: sh (the elixir and mix launcher scripts)

environment.name: SHLVL
environment.why: sh (the elixir and mix launcher scripts)

environment.name: __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING
environment.why: macOS CoreFoundation, set for every process

environment.name: ASDF_ELIXIR_VERSION
environment.why: unset by the drive for graph-side processes

environment.name: ASDF_ERLANG_VERSION
environment.why: unset by the drive for graph-side processes
